choices.why: A large 234 cm three-seat sofa in a cream tone with dark wood legs that fits well along the long left wall and suits the warm Nordic look.
A green wingback armchair that is comfortable for reading and adds the touch of green the user asked for, on light wood legs.
A square light wood coffee table with a clean Nordic design that matches the dining table.
A large 200x300 cm flatwoven rug in a warm beige that defines the seating area and goes with the cream textiles.
At 140 cm, this rectangular light wood table is the largest option and the best fit for six, in the same family as the coffee table.
Light wood chairs with a natural woven seat give a warm, classic Nordic look and match the light wood table.
A woven bamboo pendant that brings warmth and natural texture above the dining table.
A white drum-shade floor lamp, simple and Nordic, that gives soft light for reading.
A low sideboard with a white body and light wood fronts that keeps the room bright and goes with the light woods.
Light white linen curtains that filter the light from the big window without weighing down the room.
Green linen cushions that pick up the armchair's color and add the green the user asked for to the cream sofa.
A cream cable-knit throw that adds warmth and texture in the requested tone.
A tall areca palm that fills the corner and adds natural green.
A black and white abstract tree-line print that is calm and Nordic in style, without competing with the textiles.
A pair of matte stoneware vases in cream and sage, a perfect fit for the room's palette.

answer.why: Light woods, cream textiles and green accents from the armchair, cushions and palm repeat throughout the long room, linking the seating area and the dining area into one warm Nordic look.
